tables.description: Tokenizer metrics for character, whitespace word, BPE 200 merges, source-layer CV greedy, and derived f/v CV greedy tokenizers.
Key deltas: BPE versus source CV tokens per word delta and derived-versus-source coverage delta.

rights_boundary: The current package is text-only and metric-only. Corpus release, source images, and task datasets require human rights and authority clearance.
